ragTechniques.name: Naive / Dense RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Embedding-based vector retrieval

ragTechniques.name: Sparse / Lexical RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: BM25, TF-IDF or learned sparse retrieval such as SPLADE

ragTechniques.name: Hybrid RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Combine dense and sparse retrieval
ragTechniques.workflow: Query → BM25 + dense search → fusion → optional reranking → LLM
ragTechniques.bestUse: Enterprise search, product IDs and legal terminology

ragTechniques.name: Modular RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Independently configurable retrieval and generation modules

ragTechniques.name: Semantic Chunking
ragTechniques.mechanism: Split documents at meaningful semantic boundaries

ragTechniques.name: Proposition-based RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Index atomic, self-contained factual statements

ragTechniques.name: Parent-Child RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Retrieve small chunks and expand to larger parent sections

ragTechniques.name: Contextual Retrieval
ragTechniques.mechanism: Enrich chunks with document-specific context before indexing

ragTechniques.name: Late Chunking
ragTechniques.mechanism: Contextualize document tokens before pooling chunk embeddings

ragTechniques.name: Query Rewriting
ragTechniques.mechanism: Reformulate user queries for better retrieval

ragTechniques.name: HyDE
ragTechniques.mechanism: Generate hypothetical documents for embedding-based retrieval
ragTechniques.workflow: Query → hypothetical document → embedding → retrieve real evidence

ragTechniques.name: Multi-Query RAG / RAG-Fusion
ragTechniques.mechanism: Generate multiple queries and merge retrieval results

ragTechniques.name: Step-Back RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Retrieve using a more abstract, generalized question

ragTechniques.name: Query Decomposition
ragTechniques.mechanism: Break complex questions into searchable subquestions

ragTechniques.name: Reranking RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Rescore retrieved documents with cross-encoders or LLMs

ragTechniques.name: Late-Interaction RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Token-level multi-vector matching, such as ColBERT

ragTechniques.name: Multi-Hop RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Follow sequential chains of evidence

ragTechniques.name: Metadata-Aware / Filtered RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Combine semantic retrieval with structured constraints

ragTechniques.name: Federated RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Retrieve and consolidate evidence across distributed sources

ragTechniques.name: Iterative RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Alternate retrieval and intermediate reasoning

ragTechniques.name: GraphRAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Entity, relationship and graph-community retrieval
ragTechniques.workflow: Extract entities and relationships → graph/community retrieval → synthesis

ragTechniques.name: LightRAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Lightweight graph-based retrieval at different granularities

ragTechniques.name: HippoRAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Graph-based associative and multi-hop memory retrieval

ragTechniques.name: RAPTOR
ragTechniques.mechanism: Recursive hierarchical summarization and tree retrieval
ragTechniques.workflow: Recursively cluster and summarize documents → retrieve at multiple levels

ragTechniques.name: Structured / SQL-RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Retrieve evidence through SQL, JSON or structured-data interfaces

ragTechniques.name: Temporal RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Retrieve time-sensitive and historically appropriate knowledge

ragTechniques.name: Self-RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Self-reflective retrieval and generation
ragTechniques.workflow: Retrieve as needed → generate → critique evidence and answer

ragTechniques.name: Corrective RAG (CRAG)
ragTechniques.mechanism: Assess evidence and trigger corrective searches
ragTechniques.workflow: Retrieve → evaluate relevance → correct or use alternative search

ragTechniques.name: Adaptive RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Select retrieval strategies based on task requirements
ragTechniques.workflow: Classify query complexity → no retrieval, single-step or iterative retrieval

ragTechniques.name: Active RAG (FLARE)
ragTechniques.mechanism: Trigger retrieval dynamically during generation

ragTechniques.name: Agentic RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Autonomous retrieval planning and tool selection
ragTechniques.workflow: Plan → select sources/tools → retrieve → verify → iterate

ragTechniques.name: RL-based RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Learn retrieval and reasoning policies through reinforcement learning

ragTechniques.name: Contextual Compression RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Remove irrelevant information from retrieved context

ragTechniques.name: Fusion-in-Decoder (FiD)
ragTechniques.mechanism: Encode passages independently and jointly attend to them during decoding

ragTechniques.name: Grounded / Verifiable RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Evidence attribution, citations, verification and abstention

ragTechniques.name: Multimodal RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Retrieve text, images, tables, audio or video
ragTechniques.workflow: Retrieve text, images, tables or other modalities → multimodal generation

ragTechniques.name: Visual Document RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Retrieve document-page or region embeddings using vision models

ragTechniques.name: Conversational RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: History-aware retrieval and follow-up question resolution

ragTechniques.name: Memory-Augmented RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Retrieve from persistent episodic, semantic or working memory

ragTechniques.name: Long-Context Hybrid RAG
ragTechniques.mechanism: Dynamically choose or combine retrieval and long-context inference

note: Pattern insertions are educational graph blueprints with real branching/feedback links; they are NOT runnable agents or a validated domain architecture. workflow/bestUse/complexity on 10 RAG techniques and ragCompetencies are copied from the master reference §2 and §9.
